option_txt: Quando officium dicitur noctu vel summo mane
evidence: p607 Feria IV, Off. lect. H: rubric 'Quando officium dicitur noctu vel summo mane: O sator rerum (LHym 228)' then 'Quando officium dicitur diurno tempore: Christe lux vera (LHym 229)'; gregobase:10444 is Christe lux vera (the diurno option 1), so O sator rerum is the alternative.
